reviews.comment:
Dios mío, mala organización, mala señalización, pésimo servicio debido a que el personal no da abasto para la cantidad de gente que carga nafta en épocas de veranear en Brasil. Baños sucios. Debería haber un cambio de autoridades en esa YPF y mostrar mejor a la petrolera de insignia Argentina.

(Translated by Google)
My God, poor organization, bad signage, terrible service because the staff can't keep up with the number of people filling up during the summer season in Brazil. Filthy restrooms. There should be a change in management at that YPF station to better represent the iconic Argentine oil company.

reviews.comment:
El servicompras mal, no mejoran para nada, hace mas de 3 o 4 años sigue igual o peor.
Los sanitarios falta limpieza y a la hora de cargar combustible solo efectivo, ni siquiera con debito y la de siempre, los posnet no andan!
Es una estacion de servicio de bandera, creo la mas grande del pais o anda cerca y la ultima antes de cruzar la frontera o la primera cuando volves asi que tendrian que mejorar y mucho!

(Translated by Google)
The convenience store is terrible; they haven't improved at all. It's been the same or worse for over three or four years. The restrooms are filthy, and when you go to fill up, they only accept cash, not even debit cards. And the same old problem: the card machines don't work! It's a major brand gas station, I think the biggest in the country or close to it, and it's the last one before crossing the border or the first one on the way back, so they really need to improve!
